source: The price-to-annual-rent ratio for US housing in the region of 18 nationally in 2025 (Zillow / Census-derived estimates), from about 12 in cheaper metros to over 35 in the most expensive.
confidenceNote: A single national figure, recalled and rounded. Used to PROPOSE a price from the rent you pay now; the price is the first thing to change. The bands are the rule of thumb repeated in consumer guides: under 15 buying is favoured, over 20 renting is, between is neutral.
note: price ≈ monthly rent × 12 × ratio. bands: price-to-annual-rent below buyingFavouredBelow reads 'buying favoured', above rentingFavouredAbove 'renting favoured', between 'neutral'. D-088, D-099.
